steps.title: Start with 2 panels and 4 rails
steps.instruction: Join 2 panels and 4 rails (A, B, C, D, E, F), as the animation shows. Page 7 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the VITTSJÖ furniture. Page 7 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 151 cm), B (rail, about 48 cm), C (rail, about 48 cm), D (rail, about 48 cm), E (rail, about 48 cm), F (panel, about 151 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 80 cm tall.
